notes: Many sources name Aircraft Guaranty and the Mercer-Erwin conviction (2023) and sentencing (2024). None found reports AGC's current count of live registrations (364) or the 2024-26 rise in new certificates. No source found on who owns or runs AGC now. WFAA, DOJ (justice.gov EDTX release), GlobalAir and Lexology/Vedder Price pages all blocked fetch (403/429/empty), so their contents were not checked. WFAA's 'Broken Trust: New law requires FAA to close loopholes' and 'Senator highlights WFAA investigation' appeared in search but could not be opened. No coverage dated after 2026-06-30 found. The agcorp.com company site says AGC offers owner-trustee registration; not recorded as it is the company's own marketing.
